description.value:
Energetic nodes connect to the mech's weapon mounts.

Selection: When installed, choose two energy types from: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

Energize Weapon (2 PP): Convert half of a weapon's damage to one of the chosen energy types for 1 turn.

Boomerang Strike (2 PP): Grant the returning fusion to a thrown melee weapon for 1 minute.
